enum.name: DRONE_ACTION
enum.description: Atomic guidance action executed by the flight controller.

enum.name: DRONE_FAILURE_REASON
enum.description: Machine-readable reason for rejecting or failing a DroneLink operation.

enum.name: DRONE_FLIGHT_STATE
enum.description: Safety-relevant state of the STM32 flight controller.

enum.name: DRONE_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY
enum.description: Capabilities implemented by a DroneLink flight controller.

entry.name: DRONE_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY_TUNING
entry.description: PARAM_* protocol, LQG gain upload and DRONE_CTRL_DEBUG stream.

enum.name: DRONE_LEG_FLAG
enum.description: Optional behavior flags for a guidance leg.

enum.name: DRONE_LEASE_FLAG
enum.description: State carried by the operator control lease.

enum.name: DRONE_GAIN_MATRIX
enum.description: LQG gain matrix carried by DRONE_GAIN_ROW. Rows are sent in this order.

enum.name: DRONE_GAIN_ACTION
enum.description: What DRONE_GAIN_COMMIT asks the flight controller to do.

entry.name: DRONE_GAIN_ACTION_COMMIT
entry.description: Atomically replace the active gains by the staged session.

entry.name: DRONE_GAIN_ACTION_RESTORE_DEFAULT
entry.description: Return to the gains exported from Simulink.

entry.name: DRONE_GAIN_ACTION_QUERY
entry.description: Only report the active gains CRC.

enum.name: DRONE_GAIN_STATUS
enum.description: Outcome of a gain upload operation.

enum.name: DRONE_MEAS_FLAG
enum.description: Measurements refreshed in a control step.

entry.name: DRONE_MEAS_FLAG_ATTITUDE
entry.description: phi, theta, psi from the BNO08x.

entry.name: DRONE_MEAS_FLAG_GYRO
entry.description: p, q, r from the BNO08x.

entry.name: DRONE_MEAS_FLAG_RANGE
entry.description: z from the MTF-01 range finder.

entry.name: DRONE_MEAS_FLAG_FLOW
entry.description: vx, vy from the MTF-01 optical flow.

enum.name: DRONE_CTRL_FLAG
enum.description: Controller condition in a control step.

entry.name: DRONE_CTRL_FLAG_DRY_RUN
entry.description: Motors do not follow the controller.

entry.name: DRONE_CTRL_FLAG_CUSTOM_GAINS
entry.description: Gains uploaded at run time, not the Simulink ones.

entry.name: DRONE_CTRL_FLAG_SATURATED
entry.description: At least one motor hit MOT_MIN or MOT_MAX.

message.name: DRONE_PROTOCOL_INFO
message.description: DroneLink version, boot identity, capabilities and current flight state.
message.field: Monotonic STM32 boot identity. Zero is invalid for movement.
Implemented capabilities.
Largest accepted leg timeout.
DroneLink major version.
DroneLink minor version.
Current flight state.
Intended recipient system, zero for broadcast.
Intended recipient component, zero for broadcast.

message.name: DRONE_LEG_COMMAND
message.description: Idempotent request to execute one bounded guidance leg.
message.field: Expected STM32 boot identity.
Persistent mission identity.
Monotonic command identity within the mission.
Absolute execution timeout.
X objective in the selected frame.
Y objective in the selected frame.
Z objective in the selected frame.
Yaw objective or relative delta.
Maximum translational speed.
Maximum translational acceleration.
Position completion tolerance.
Yaw completion tolerance.
Monotonic leg index in the compiled route.
Requested behavior flags.
Guidance action.
Coordinate frame.
System that must execute the command.
Component that must execute the command.

message.name: DRONE_LEG_ACK
message.description: Application acknowledgement and progress for one exact leg transaction.
message.field: STM32 boot identity echoed from the command.
Mission identity echoed from the command.
Command identity echoed from the command.
Estimated remaining execution time, UINT32_MAX if unknown.
Estimated remaining distance, NaN if unknown.
Leg index echoed from the command.
Failure or rejection reason.
Command result.
Progress from 0 to 100, 255 if unknown.
Current flight state.
Intended recipient system.
Intended recipient component.

message.name: DRONE_LEG_CANCEL
message.description: Idempotent cancellation of one exact leg transaction.
message.field: Expected STM32 boot identity.
Mission identity.
Command identity being cancelled.
Leg index being cancelled.
System that must process the cancellation.
Component that must process the cancellation.

message.name: DRONE_CONTROL_LEASE
message.description: Renewable authorization proving that an operator session supervises the mission.
message.field: STM32 boot identity observed by the Pi.
Mission currently supervised, zero when none.
Identity changed whenever a new operator lease is acquired.
Validity measured from local receipt time.
Lease state flags.
System that validates the lease.
Component that validates the lease.

message.name: DRONE_GAIN_ROW
message.description: One row of an LQG gain matrix, staged until DRONE_GAIN_COMMIT.
message.field: Upload session chosen by the Pi, non-zero. A new session discards the previous staging.
Row values; only the first count are used.
Matrix of this row.
Row index inside the matrix.
Number of columns, must match the matrix.
System that must stage the row.
Component that must stage the row.

message.name: DRONE_GAIN_COMMIT
message.description: Commit, abort or restore LQG gains. Answered by DRONE_GAIN_ACK.
message.field: Upload session to commit or abort.
CRC-32 (zlib) of all 280 values as float32 little-endian, in the order Kd, Kfd, L, M, row by row.
Requested action.
System that must process the request.
Component that must process the request.

message.name: DRONE_GAIN_ACK
message.description: Result of a gain upload operation.
message.field: Session echoed from the request.
CRC-32 computed over the staged values.
CRC-32 of the gains in use after the operation.
Staged rows, bit i = row i in the order Kd, Kfd, L, M.
Action echoed from the request.
Outcome.
1 if the active gains are not the Simulink defaults.
Intended recipient system.
Intended recipient component.

message.name: DRONE_CTRL_DEBUG
message.description: One LQG step: measurements, estimate, command and reference. Rate set by the DBG_RATE_HZ parameter.
message.field: STM32 tick of the step.
Control steps since boot.
Measurements z, phi, theta, psi, vx, vy, p, q, r (SI, NED).
Kalman estimate x, y, z, phi, theta, psi, vx, vy, vz, p, q, r (SI, NED).
LQG output: motor speed deviation from hover.
Reference x, y, z, psi (m, m, m, rad).
Throttle of each motor, 0 to 10000 (also computed in dry run).
Flight state.
Measurements refreshed in this step.
Controller condition.

message.name: DRONE_NAV_DEBUG
message.description: Navigation EKF step (control/nav_ekf.h): optical flow, range finder and BNO08x linear acceleration fused into position, velocity and accelerometer bias in x, y (local frame) and z (NED). Sent at NAV_DBG_HZ (0 = off) so the Pi can validate the horizontal estimate and the quality of z.
message.field: STM32 tick of the step.
MTF-01 flow, sensor x and y.
Flow velocity in body axes (forward, right), after scale and gyro compensation, before fusion.
Range finder reading.
Range after the jump gate and low-pass filter.
EKF position x, y (local) and z (NED, negative above ground).
EKF velocity vx, vy (local) and vz (NED, negative = climbing).
EKF accelerometer bias x, y, z.
Linear acceleration used in the prediction: x, y (local) and down.
Last innovation test ratio of the x/y pair (above 1 = rejected).
Last innovation test ratio of z (above 1 = rejected).
Flow corrections rejected by the gate (wraps).
Range corrections rejected by the EKF gate (wraps).
Readings rejected by the range filter (wraps).
Bits: 1 new MTF frame, 2 flow fused, 4 flow rejected, 8 xy usable, 16 xy sent to the LQG, 32 range rejected, 64 z rejected, 128 z usable, 256 z sent to the LQG.
MTF-01 flow quality, 0 to 255.
